stem.en: A wheel rolling without slipping doubles its angular velocity. What happens to its rotational kinetic energy?
stem.et: Libisemata veerev ratas kahekordistab oma nurkkiiruse. Mis juhtub selle pöörlemise kineetilise energiaga?

label.en: It becomes four times larger, since the energy goes as ω²
label.et: See suureneb neli korda, sest energia sõltub ω²-st

label.en: It doubles, in step with the angular velocity
It is unchanged, because rolling energy is fixed by the wheel's mass
label.et: See ei muutu, sest veeremisenergia on määratud ratta massiga

label.en: It stays zero as long as the wheel's centre keeps moving steadily
label.et: See jääb nulliks, kuni ratta kese liigub ühtlaselt
